task.description:
Run the full test suite and report results for PD-06.

### Commands to run (in order)

```bash
zig build
zig build test
```

Both must be run and their exit codes recorded.

### Report format

Write a structured test report to `tests/reports/WF02-pd06-20260521-test-report.json` with the following fields:
- run_id
- requirement_ids
- timestamp
- zig_build_exit_code
- zig_build_test_exit_code
- tests_run (count)
- tests_passed (count)
- tests_failed (count)
- failed_tests (array of { name, error })
- status: "PASS" or "FAIL"

### Pass criteria

Result is PASS only if ALL of the following are true:
- `zig build` exits 0
- `zig build test` exits 0
- All TC-PD-06-XX test functions pass
- No regressions in previously passing tests (graph_test.zig, graph_node_attributes_test.zig)

If any test fails, set result.status = "FAIL" and list all failures with full error text in result.issues.
acceptance_criteria: No regressions in existing graph tests
